svg.title: Ktemata r5 airbrush scheme - STRATA
svg.desc: Continuity: the stack is keyed to x, not to y, so each rail runs dead straight from the cover into the deck and the U closes across the hinge. 32 mm of bands fills the deck's 40.95 mm rail, but the 7" bezel leaves only 14.6 mm of cover plate beside it, so on the cover the outer bands now run under the bezel ring instead of beside it. Kept as the record of an alternative: on the 7" layout Meridian is the scheme that works.
